licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score: Sento, o Dio (the libretto has oddio), Il mio l'abbro, girle avante, non tene andrai, and the asides in brackets.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 36–47, bars 1–108 of No. 6
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by three fresh checkers, one per page range (one error found in bar 66 and corrected; the other two ranges clean). The German singing translation is left out. The editorial [f] in bar 1 and the asides in brackets in bars 40–46 and 69–75 are kept as printed; two printed slurs that cross between staves or voices, in bars 103 and 107, cannot be encoded and are left out. Playback tempo: a half note = 56 (♩ = 112), estimated from two recordings (Kuijken 4:49, Hager 4:25) whose tracks also hold the following recitative, so about 45 seconds were taken off; Mozart gives the word Andante only.
